biggest_catch: You must have been a WFCU member for at least 3 months to qualify - and the friend must mention your referral at the time of application, not later.
catches: Referring member earns $25 if the friend is approved for a personal loan, $50 for an auto loan, $100 for a home equity loan.
Referrer must be a member in good standing for at least 3 months.
The referred person cannot be a current WFCU member.
The referral must be mentioned at the time of application - retroactive credit is not available.
Approval of the loan is required (application alone earns nothing).
No cap stated on the official page.
No tax language on the page (standard bonus treatment; not stated).
